title: Paribus — Concentrated Liquidity NFT Collateral Overvaluation Analysis
root_cause: Collateral valuation logic overestimates the actual value of concentrated liquidity NFTs with extreme tick ranges (-870000~870000), allowing over-borrowing
steps: → [2] Swap USDT → PBX via Camelot Router
→ [3] Mint concentrated liquidity NFT with extreme tick range
→ [4] Enter Paribus market with NFT (register as collateral)
→ [5] Borrow multiple assets using overvalued collateral
